question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

By leaps and bounds
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"By leaps and bounds"** means something that is happening very quickly or rapidly. (बहुत तेजी से)

 
 
• **Example: **The company's profits have increased ***by leaps and bounds* **this year.
 
 
 
• **Rapidly** refers to something happening in a fast or swift manner. (तेजी से)
 
 
• **Example: **The disease spread ***rapidly*** through the community.
 
 

Therefore, the correct meaning of the given idiom is: **Rapidly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unknowingly** (अनजाने में): Without being aware of a situation or fact.

 
 
• **Example:** She **unknowingly **walked into a dangerous area.
 
 
 
• **Normally** (सामान्यतः): In a usual or typical manner.
 
 
• **Example:** **Normally,** I wake up at 6 AM.
 
 
 
• **Slowly** (धीरे-धीरे): At a slow speed; not quickly.
 
 
• **Example:** He walked **slowly** down the street, enjoying the evening air.
